label: rust

harness.now_source: auto: newest day with a screenshot and an owner read

metrics.label: Cold start to first frame
metrics.method: Stopwatch from Process.Start to the --bench-data-ready line, minus the (data_ready_ms - first_frame_ms) the process reports on its own clock = start to first frame on the outside clock; window_ms = same clock to the first visible window; before each launch: admin

metrics.label: Warm start to first frame
metrics.method: Stopwatch from Process.Start to the --bench-data-ready line, minus the (data_ready_ms - first_frame_ms) the process reports on its own clock = start to first frame on the outside clock; window_ms = same clock to the first visible window; right after a previous launch

metrics.label: Cold start to the day data drawn
metrics.method: Stopwatch from Process.Start to the {"data_ready_ms"} line on stdout (--bench-data-ready): the day of the vault (-Vault) drawn; before each launch: admin

metrics.label: Warm start to the day data drawn
metrics.method: Stopwatch from Process.Start to the {"data_ready_ms"} line on stdout (--bench-data-ready): the day of the vault (-Vault) drawn; right after a previous launch

metrics.label: Idle RAM, Working Set
metrics.method: variant default; launch, first visible window, 10 s settle (not counted), then 60 s idle; memory = sum over the process tree at the end, Process.WorkingSet64

metrics.label: Idle RAM, Private Bytes
metrics.method: variant default; launch, first visible window, 10 s settle (not counted), then 60 s idle; memory = sum over the process tree at the end, Process.PrivateMemorySize64 (= Private Bytes)

metrics.label: Idle CPU
metrics.method: TotalProcessorTime of the tree sampled every 1 s over the idle window / wall / logical CPUs (Task Manager scale)

metrics.label: Frames per minute when idle
metrics.method: sum of "frames" in DESK_FRAME_STATS=1 stderr lines inside the idle window

metrics.label: Frame p50 while streaming
metrics.note: fake-claude did not finish its stream in time

metrics.label: Frame p95 while streaming
metrics.note: fake-claude did not finish its stream in time

metrics.label: Frame p99 while streaming
metrics.note: fake-claude did not finish its stream in time

metrics.label: Frame p50 while switching days
metrics.method: variant default; strategy-desk --bench-switch 1500 with DESK_FRAME_STATS=1 on the vault (-Vault); per-10-s windows, p95/p99 judged on the worst window

metrics.label: Frame p95 while switching days
metrics.method: variant default; strategy-desk --bench-switch 1500 with DESK_FRAME_STATS=1 on the vault (-Vault); per-10-s windows, p95/p99 judged on the worst window

metrics.label: Frame p99 while switching days
metrics.method: variant default; strategy-desk --bench-switch 1500 with DESK_FRAME_STATS=1 on the vault (-Vault); per-10-s windows, p95/p99 judged on the worst window

metrics.label: Day switch, command to frame
metrics.method: variant default; strategy-desk --bench-switch 1500 with DESK_FRAME_STATS=1 on the vault (-Vault); each switch: the Command to the start of the frame after the one that drew the new day (desk-ui clock)

metrics.label: Installed folder size
metrics.note: exe is not under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs (a build folder is not an installation)

metrics.label: Private Bytes growth over the soak
